assets.selection: Typical OA signs: visible inferior humeral-head osteophyte and narrowed glenohumeral joint space, without marked superior migration. No numeric grade assigned.

assets.prompt: Create a refined educational anatomical illustration for a radiology lesson header: glenohumeral osteoarthritis. A single anatomically plausible shoulder joint, humeral head articulating with shallow glenoid scapula, small inferior humeral osteophyte and subtly narrowed cartilage region highlighted muted amber. Clean ivory bone, teal-blue background, elegant professional medical atlas painting, readable small-scale composition. No text, no labels, no logos, no X-ray/CT/MRI simulation, no diagnostic scan. Landscape composition. Non-diagnostic schematic, avoid extra bones or dislocated joint.
